title: Amazing Energizing Jamaican Kimchi Bowl
description: A fermented and energizing Jamaican dish featuring fresh basil and gluten-free friendly kimchi, this bowl is perfect for a healthy lunch option. It combines the spicy and sour flavors of kimchi with the freshness of basil.
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package instructions.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked brown rice, kimchi, and chopped fresh basil.
In a small bowl, mix together the jamaican jerk seasoning, lime juice, salt, and black pepper to make the dressing.
Add the diced red onion and scotch bonnet pepper to the bowl with the rice mixture.
Pour the dressing over the rice mixture and toss to combine.
Drizzle the olive oil over the top of the bowl and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional chopped fresh basil if desired.
Let it sit for a few minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
